relationships.subject: cerebellin 1
relationships.evidence_quote: Importantly, IV Cbln1 was able to normalize the expression of these subunits close to sham levels (Figure 6C).

key_findings: A single intravenous recombinant Cbln1 injection relieved inflammatory and cisplatin-induced neuropathic pain in a GluD1-dependent manner.
IV Cbln1 reached spinal cord synapses (indicating BBB permeability) and normalized spinal GluD1, GluN2A, GluA1 and GluA2 but not in the central amygdala.
